description: This is a test source file for a Spring Boot project template in Python, utilizing pytest fixtures and tests to verify the functionality of project initialization, configuration, template content, and structure. It defines fixtures to create mock directories and files, and contains multiple test functions to ensure that the template behaves as expected, including content validation and correct variable replacements.

methods.description: Fixture that creates and cleans up a temporary directory for testing.

methods.description: Fixture that creates a sample ProjectConfig object for testing.
